question: Can you locate a hotel within a 90 kilometers radius around Rollins Avenue Park, Capitol Heights, MD?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT p.geometry::geography FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Rollins Avenue Park%' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Capitol Heights%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ) ) LIMIT 1 ), 90000 );
